say:1:1041576501:1.text: Peggy, how did you manage to sneak out of the palace this time?
say:1:1041576501:1.source_cn: 佩吉，你这次又是怎么从王宫里溜出来的？

say:2:1041576502:1.text: How else? I climbed out the second-floor window during a break in my etiquette lessons!
say:2:1041576502:1.source_cn: 还能怎么出来，趁着礼仪课的课间，从二楼的窗户爬出来的呗！

say:3:1041576503:1.text: Honestly, that teacher is way too long-winded. If I kept listening, I swear mushrooms would start growing out of my ears!
say:3:1041576503:1.source_cn: 那个教导仪态的礼仪老师实在太啰嗦了，要是继续听下去，我...

say:4:1041576504:1.text: What about the guards who were tailing you?
say:4:1041576504:1.source_cn: 那些跟在你屁股后面的卫兵呢？

say:5:1041576505:1.source_cn: 当然是被本公主甩在身后了！

say:6:1041576506:1.text: They're already kind of clumsy, and their armor makes them even slower. I slipped away from them easily.
say:6:1041576506:1.source_cn: 那些卫兵本来就笨笨的，穿上盔甲后动作更不灵活了，轻轻松...

say:7:1041576507:1.text: Just so you know... there were a few times you swore you lost them...
say:7:1041576507:1.source_cn: 悄悄告诉你，有那么几次，你明明告诉我你甩开了卫兵……

say:8:1041576508:1.text: But whenever we were walking through town and turned a corner, I'd still spot them quietly following behind us.
say:8:1041576508:1.source_cn: 可是走在街上的时候，每次拐弯我都发现，还是有卫兵在后面...

say:9:1041576509:1.text: What? You mean they let me think I'd escaped?! They were just pretending?!
say:9:1041576509:1.source_cn: 你是说，他们假装自己被我甩开了，其实还偷偷跟在后面！

say:10:1041576510:1.text: ... Since when did they get that clever?! And I was completely oblivious!
say:10:1041576510:1.source_cn: ……他们、他们什么时候变得这么聪明了！而我还一直被蒙在鼓里！

say:11:1041576511:1.text: Maybe this was the Queen's doing? She probably gave them orders.
say:11:1041576511:1.source_cn: 说不定……是王后陛下的安排？

say:12:1041576512:1.text: Mother really is something... I just wanted some free time to myself.
say:12:1041576512:1.source_cn: 母后也真是的，我只是想有一点自己的自由时间。

say:13:1041576513:1.text: You have to see her side of it. If you're wandering the city without a guard and you run into someone dangerous, what would you do?
say:13:1041576513:1.source_cn: 王后陛下的安排也有道理，你想，如果没有卫兵保护，你一个...

say:14:1041576514:1.text: I can protect myself just fine!
say:14:1041576514:1.source_cn: 本公主可以自己保护自己！

say:15:1041576515:1.text: What if it's someone really strong? The kind only someone like <style="stress"><player_name></style> could beat?
say:15:1041576515:1.source_cn: 如果是很强大的坏人呢？只有<style=stress>...
say:15:1041576515:1.male: What if it's someone really strong? The kind only someone like <style="stress"><player_name></style> could beat?
say:15:1041576515:1.female: What if it's someone really strong? The kind only someone like <style="stress"><player_name></style> could beat?

say:16:1041576516:1.text: T-then... you'd be there too! You could hold them off, and sneak away to get <style="stress"><player_name></style> to help!
say:16:1041576516:1.source_cn: 那、那不是还有你嘛！你可以在一旁牵制，也可以趁乱溜走找...
say:16:1041576516:1.male: T-then... you'd be there too! You could hold them off, and sneak away to get <style="stress"><player_name></style> to help!
say:16:1041576516:1.female: T-then... you'd be there too! You could hold them off, and sneak away to get <style="stress"><player_name></style> to help!

say:17:1041576517:1.text: Being your bodyguard sounds like it should come with a salary.
say:17:1041576517:1.source_cn: 要我承担护卫的工作，可是要付薪水的。

say:18:1041576518:1.text: Hmph. I should've known you'd bring up money. At this point, I might as well just keep the Royal Guard.
say:18:1041576518:1.source_cn: 哼，我就知道你会这么说。这样的话，还不如让卫兵来保护我呢。

say:19:1041576519:1.text: Mother probably knew you couldn't be relied on, so she sent them instead!
say:19:1041576519:1.source_cn: 母后肯定早就知道你靠不住，才派了卫兵来保护我！

say:20:1041576520:1.text: That's it! When I get back to the palace, I'm going to give those guards a massive reward for all their hard work lately!
say:20:1041576520:1.source_cn: 决定了！等我回了宫，要好好犒劳这段时间一直辛苦工作的卫兵！

say:21:1041576521:1.text: ... In the end, the only one working hard with no pay is me, huh...
say:21:1041576521:1.source_cn: 唉，到头来，任劳任怨却没有报酬的人只有我啊……
